## Event Categories

### Browsing
- **Products Searched** — user searched for products
- **Product List Viewed** — user viewed product list or category
- **Product List Filtered** — user filtered product list or category

### Promotions
- **Promotion Viewed** — user viewed promotion
- **Promotion Clicked** — user clicked promotion

### Core Ordering
- **Product Clicked** — user clicked on product
- **Product Viewed** — user viewed product details
- **Product Added** — user added product to cart
- **Product Removed** — user removed product from cart
- **Cart Viewed** — user viewed shopping cart
- **Checkout Started** — user initiated order process
- **Checkout Step Viewed** — user viewed checkout step
- **Checkout Step Completed** — user completed checkout step
- **Payment Info Entered** — user added payment information
- **Order Completed** — user completed order
- **Order Updated** — user updated order
- **Order Refunded** — user refunded order
- **Order Cancelled** — user cancelled order

### Coupons
- **Coupon Entered** — user entered coupon on cart or order
- **Coupon Applied** — coupon successfully applied
- **Coupon Denied** — coupon was denied
- **Coupon Removed** — user removed coupon

### Wishlisting
- **Product Added to Wishlist** — user added product to wishlist
- **Product Removed from Wishlist** — user removed product from wishlist
- **Wishlist Product Added to Cart** — user moved wishlist product to cart

### Sharing
- **Product Shared** — user shared product with one or more friends
- **Cart Shared** — user shared cart with one or more friends

### Reviewing
- **Product Reviewed** — user reviewed product

---

## Event Specs

### Products Searched

```js
analytics.track('Products Searched', {
  query: 'blue roses'
});
```

| Property | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| query | String \| Object | Query user searched with |

### Product List Viewed

```js
analytics.track('Product List Viewed', {
  list_id: 'hot_deals_1',
  category: 'Deals',
  products: [
    {
      product_id: '507f1f77bcf86cd799439011',
      sku: '45790-32',
      name: 'Monopoly: 3rd Edition',
      price: 19,
      position: 1,
      category: 'Games',
      url: 'https://www.example.com/product/path',
      image_url: 'https://www.example.com/product/path.jpg'
    },
    {
      product_id: '505bd76785ebb509fc183733',
      sku: '46493-32',
      name: 'Uno Card Game',
      price: 3,
      position: 2,
      category: 'Games'
    }
  ]
});
```

| Property | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| list_id | String | Product list being viewed |
| category | String | Product category being viewed |
| products | Array<Product> | Products displayed in list |
| products.$.product_id | String | Product id |
| products.$.sku | String | Product SKU |
| products.$.category | String | Product category |
| products.$.name | String | Product name |
| products.$.brand | String | Brand |
| products.$.variant | String | Product variant |
| products.$.price | Number | Price ($) |
| products.$.quantity | Number | Quantity |
| products.$.coupon | String | Coupon code |
| products.$.position | Number | Position in list |
| products.$.url | String | Product page URL |
| products.$.image_url | String | Product image URL |

### Product List Filtered

```js
analytics.track('Product List Filtered', {
  list_id: 'todays_deals_may_11_2019',
  filters: [
    {
      type: 'department',
      value: 'beauty'
    },
    {
      type: 'price',
      value: 'under-$25'
    },
  ],
  sorts: [
    {
      type: 'price',
      value: 'desc'
    }
  ],
  products: [
    {
      product_id: '507f1f77bcf86cd798439011',
      sku: '45360-32',
      name: 'Special Facial Soap',
      price: 12.60,
      position: 1,
      category: 'Beauty',
      url: 'https://www.example.com/product/path',
      image_url: 'https://www.example.com/product/path.jpg'
    }
  ]
});
```

| Property | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| list_id | String | Product list being viewed |
| category | String | Product category being viewed |
| filters | Array | Product filters customer is using |
| filters.$.type | String | Filter type ID |
| filters.$.value | String | Filter selection ID |
| sorts | Array<Sort> | Product sorting |
| sorts.$.type | String | Sort type ID |
| sorts.$.value | String | Sort value (ascending, descending) |
| products | Array | Products in list |
| products.$ | Product | (same schema as Product List Viewed) |

### Checkout Started

```js
analytics.track('Checkout Started', {
  order_id: '50314b8e9bcf000000000000',
  affiliation: 'Google Store',
  value: 30,
  revenue: 25.00,
  shipping: 3,
  tax: 2,
  discount: 2.5,
  coupon: 'hasbros',
  currency: 'USD',
  products: [
    {
      product_id: '507f1f77bcf86cd799439011',
      sku: '45790-32',
      name: 'Monopoly: 3rd Edition',
      price: 19,
      quantity: 1,
      category: 'Games',
      url: 'https://www.example.com/product/path',
      image_url: 'https://www.example.com/product/path.jpg'
    },
    {
      product_id: '505bd76785ebb509fc183733',
      sku: '46493-32',
      name: 'Uno Card Game',
      price: 3,
      quantity: 2,
      category: 'Games'
    }
  ]
});
```

| Property | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| order_id | String | Order/transaction ID |
| affiliation | String | Store or affiliation |
| value | Number | Revenue ($) with discounts and coupons |
| revenue | Number | Revenue ($) excluding shipping and tax |
| shipping | Number | Shipping cost |
| tax | Number | Total tax |
| discount | Number | Total discount |
| coupon | String | Transaction coupon code |
| currency | String | Currency code |
| products | Array | Products in order |
| products.$ | Product | (Product schema) |

### Product Shared

```js

  share_via: 'email',
  share_message: 'Hey, check out this item',

  product_id: '507f1f77bcf86cd799439011',
  sku: 'G-32',
  category: 'Games',
  name: 'Monopoly: 3rd Edition',
  brand: 'Hasbro',
  variant: '200 pieces',
  price: 18.99,
  url: 'https://www.example.com/product/path',
  image_url: 'https://www.example.com/product/path.jpg'
});
```

| Property | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| share_via | String | Method of sharing |
| share_message | String | Message from sender |
| recipient | String | Recipient of sharing |
| product_id | String | Database ID |
| sku | String | Product SKU |
| category | String | Product category |
| name | String | Product name |
| brand | String | Brand |
| variant | String | Product variant |
| price | Number | Price ($) |
| url | String | Product page URL |
| image_url | String | Product image URL |

### Cart Shared

```js
analytics.track('Cart Shared', {
  share_via: 'email',
  share_message: 'Hey, check out this item',
  recipient: 'friend@example.com',
  cart_id: 'd92jd29jd92jd29j92d92jd',
  products: [
    { product_id: '507f1f77bcf86cd799439011' },
    { product_id: '505bd76785ebb509fc183733' }
  ]
});
```

| Property | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| share_via | String | Method of sharing |
| share_message | String | Message from sender |
| recipient | String | Recipient of sharing |
| cart_id | String | Shopping cart ID |
| products | Array | Products in cart |
| products.$.product_id | String | Product ID |

---

## Reviewing

### Product Reviewed

```js
analytics.track('Product Reviewed', {
  product_id: '507f1f77bcf86cd799439011',
  review_id: 'kdfjrj39fj39jf3',
  review_body: 'I love this product',
  rating: '5'
});
```

| Property | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| product_id | String | Product ID |
| review_id | String | Review ID |
| review_body | String | Review body |
| rating | String | Review rating |

---

## Notes

- `product_id` and `sku` don't have to differ; typically `product_id` is a database identifier (e.g., `9714107479`) and `sku` is a public-facing identifier (e.g., `SEG-02`).
- Not all destinations accept arrays as properties — check individual destination documentation.
